enum.name: COMPONENT_ROLE
enum.description: Logical role of a component in the boat system.

entry.name: COMPONENT_ROLE_UNKNOWN
entry.description: Role is unknown or has not been configured.

entry.name: COMPONENT_ROLE_BRAIN
entry.description: Main computer responsible for navigation and mission control.

entry.name: COMPONENT_ROLE_GROUND_STATION
entry.description: Operator CLI, GUI, or ground-control station.

entry.name: CAPABILITY_FLAGS_POWER_MANAGEMENT
entry.description: Controls or reports system power modes.

entry.name: CAPABILITY_FLAGS_BUS_MASTER
entry.description: Schedules access to the shared half-duplex bus.

entry.name: CAPABILITY_FLAGS_BUS_CLIENT
entry.description: Uses grants from the shared half-duplex bus master.

enum.name: CONTROL_SOURCE
enum.description: Source currently permitted to command an actuator.

entry.name: CONTROL_SOURCE_AUTONOMOUS
entry.description: Autonomous control from the main computer.

entry.name: CONTROL_SOURCE_REMOTE_OPERATOR
entry.description: Remote operator command relayed through the main computer.

enum.name: COMMAND_RESULT
enum.description: Result of applying the latest actuator command.

entry.name: COMMAND_RESULT_IN_PROGRESS
entry.description: Command was accepted and the actuator is still moving.

entry.name: COMMAND_RESULT_DENIED
entry.description: Command was denied by the current control-authority policy.

entry.name: COMMAND_RESULT_INVALID
entry.description: Command contained an unsupported actuator, range, or value.

entry.name: COMMAND_RESULT_TIMEOUT
entry.description: Command expired before or while it was being applied.

entry.name: COMMAND_RESULT_FAULT
entry.description: Command could not be applied because of a hardware fault.

enum.name: FAULT_FLAGS
enum.description: Faults common to the boat computers, links, sensors, and actuators.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_SENSOR
entry.description: Sensor missing, stale, or outside its valid range.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_UNDERVOLTAGE
entry.description: Supply voltage is below its configured safe threshold.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_OVERCURRENT
entry.description: Current is above its configured safe threshold.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_OVERTEMPERATURE
entry.description: Temperature is above its configured safe threshold.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_WATCHDOG
entry.description: A watchdog reset or missed deadline occurred.

entry.name: FAULT_FLAGS_LEAK
entry.description: Water ingress or leak was detected.

entry.name: POWER_MODE_TYPE_FULL_ACTIVE
entry.description: All configured systems are powered and active.

entry.name: POWER_MODE_TYPE_LOW_POWER
entry.description: Nonessential loads and telemetry rates are reduced.

entry.name: POWER_MODE_TYPE_SAFE
entry.description: Only systems required to remain safe and recover are active.

enum.name: ENVIRONMENTAL_VALIDITY
enum.description: Fields that contain a valid measurement in ENVIRONMENTAL_SAMPLE.

entry.name: ENVIRONMENTAL_VALIDITY_WATER_TEMPERATURE
entry.description: The water temperature field is valid.

entry.name: ENVIRONMENTAL_VALIDITY_DISSOLVED_OXYGEN
entry.description: The dissolved oxygen field is valid.

entry.name: LINK_TYPE_USB
entry.description: USB or local development serial link.

entry.name: LINK_TYPE_I2C
entry.description: Onboard shared I2C bus between the single-controller computer and its addressed peers.

enum.name: MOVEMENT_OPCODE
enum.description: Operation requested by one ACTUATOR_REQUEST movement envelope.

entry.name: MOVEMENT_OPCODE_NONE
entry.description: No operation. The request is invalid and must be rejected without moving the actuator.

entry.name: MOVEMENT_OPCODE_ABSOLUTE
entry.description: Move to the absolute angle carried in delta_cdeg.

entry.name: MOVEMENT_OPCODE_STEP
entry.description: Resolve the signed relative delta in delta_cdeg exactly once against valid fresh actuator feedback, then move to the resolved absolute target.

entry.name: MOVEMENT_OPCODE_STOP
entry.description: Cancel the active or queued movement and hold. Distinct from a zero-degree absolute target. delta_cdeg must be zero.

enum.name: MOTOR_STATE
enum.description: Progress state of one movement request at the reporting node. Reported states are distinct observations and must not be collapsed.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_UNKNOWN
entry.description: The state is not known, for example after a reboot or a lost response.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_RECEIVED
entry.description: The request was received and is awaiting validation.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_ACCEPTED
entry.description: The request passed validation and is queued, but motion has not started.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_RUNNING
entry.description: The actuator is moving under this request.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_COMPLETED
entry.description: The requested movement reached its target.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_STOPPED
entry.description: The movement was stopped before completion, by STOP, timeout, or preemption.

entry.name: MOTOR_STATE_REJECTED
entry.description: The request was rejected. The rejection is identified independently of the last accepted action.

enum.name: CORRELATION_RESULT
enum.description: Correlated outcome of one ground-issued movement request. These values do not modify COMMAND_RESULT, which keeps its existing meaning in ACTUATOR_STATUS.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_UNKNOWN
entry.description: The outcome is not known. The next step is status inspection, never a repeat movement.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_COMPLETED
entry.description: The request completed its requested movement.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_DENIED
entry.description: The request was denied by authority policy, for example while RC owns the actuator.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_INVALID
entry.description: The request was invalid, for example a bad actuator, range, target, or a STOP with a nonzero delta.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_STALE
entry.description: The request expired or arrived after a session or boot change.

entry.name: CORRELATION_RESULT_SUPERSEDED
entry.description: A newer request replaced this one before it completed.

enum.name: RESET_REASON
enum.description: Why the reporting node last restarted. Report UNKNOWN rather than guessing.

entry.name: RESET_REASON_UNKNOWN
entry.description: The reset reason is not known or not measured.

entry.name: RESET_REASON_POWER_ON
entry.description: Power was applied or the node was manually reset.

entry.name: RESET_REASON_WATCHDOG
entry.description: A watchdog or missed-deadline reset occurred.

entry.name: RESET_REASON_BROWNOUT
entry.description: Supply voltage fell below the reset threshold.

enum.name: SENSOR_VALID_FIELDS
enum.description: Measurements currently valid at the reporting node. Used to mark unmeasured fields, such as SCALED_IMU magnetometer and temperature, invalid instead of reporting zero as a real measurement.

enum.name: BUS_STREAM_FLAGS
enum.description: Classes of queued traffic that a bus client may transmit during a grant.

entry.name: BUS_STREAM_FLAGS_CRITICAL
entry.description: Critical fault, control, and acknowledgement traffic.

entry.name: BUS_STREAM_FLAGS_STATUS
entry.description: Component, actuator, power, and link status.

entry.name: BUS_STREAM_FLAGS_FAST_SENSOR
entry.description: High-rate navigation and control sensor samples.

enum.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT
enum.description: Micro air vehicle / autopilot classes. This identifies the individual model.

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC
entry.description: Generic autopilot, full support for everything

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC_WAYPOINTS_ONLY
entry.description: Generic autopilot only supporting simple waypoints

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC_WAYPOINTS_AND_SIMPLE_NAVIGATION_ONLY
entry.description: Generic autopilot supporting waypoints and other simple navigation commands

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_GENERIC_MISSION_FULL
entry.description: Generic autopilot supporting the full mission command set

entry.name: MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID
entry.description: No valid autopilot, e.g. a GCS or other MAVLink component

enum.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG
enum.description: These flags encode the MAV mode, see MAV_MODE enum for useful combinations.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_SAFETY_ARMED
entry.description: 0b10000000 MAV safety set to armed. Motors are enabled / running / can start. Ready to fly. Additional note: this flag is to be ignored when sent in the command MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MODE and MAV_CMD_COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM shall be used instead. The flag can still be used to report the armed state.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_HIL_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00100000 hardware in the loop simulation. All motors / actuators are blocked, but internal software is full operational.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_STABILIZE_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00010000 system stabilizes electronically its attitude (and optionally position). It needs however further control inputs to move around.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_GUIDED_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00001000 guided mode enabled, system flies waypoints / mission items.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_AUTO_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00000100 autonomous mode enabled, system finds its own goal positions. Guided flag can be set or not, depends on the actual implementation.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_TEST_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00000010 system has a test mode enabled. This flag is intended for temporary system tests and should not be used for stable implementations.

entry.name: MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED
entry.description: 0b00000001 system-specific custom mode is enabled. When using this flag to enable a custom mode all other flags should be ignored.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_CALIBRATING
entry.description: System is calibrating and not flight-ready.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_STANDBY
entry.description: System is grounded and on standby. It can be launched any time.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_ACTIVE
entry.description: System is active and might be already airborne. Motors are engaged.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_CRITICAL
entry.description: System is in a non-normal flight mode (failsafe). It can however still navigate.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_EMERGENCY
entry.description: System is in a non-normal flight mode (failsafe). It lost control over parts or over the whole airframe. It is in mayday and going down.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_POWEROFF
entry.description: System just initialized its power-down sequence, will shut down now.

entry.name: MAV_STATE_FLIGHT_TERMINATION
entry.description: System is terminating itself (failsafe or commanded).

enum.name: MAV_TYPE
enum.description: MAVLINK component type reported in HEARTBEAT message. Flight controllers must report the type of the vehicle on which they are mounted (e.g. MAV_TYPE_OCTOROTOR). All other components must report a value appropriate for their type (e.g. a camera must use MAV_TYPE_CAMERA).

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_GCS
entry.description: Operator control unit / ground control station

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TAILSITTER_DUOROTOR
entry.description: Two-rotor Tailsitter VTOL that additionally uses control surfaces in vertical operation. Note, value previously named MAV_TYPE_VTOL_DUOROTOR.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TAILSITTER_QUADROTOR
entry.description: Quad-rotor Tailsitter VTOL using a V-shaped quad config in vertical operation. Note: value previously named MAV_TYPE_VTOL_QUADROTOR.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TILTROTOR
entry.description: Tiltrotor VTOL. Fuselage and wings stay (nominally) horizontal in all flight phases. It able to tilt (some) rotors to provide thrust in cruise flight.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_FIXEDROTOR
entry.description: VTOL with separate fixed rotors for hover and cruise flight. Fuselage and wings stay (nominally) horizontal in all flight phases.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TAILSITTER
entry.description: Tailsitter VTOL. Fuselage and wings orientation changes depending on flight phase: vertical for hover, horizontal for cruise. Use more specific VTOL MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TAILSITTER_DUOROTOR or MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TAILSITTER_QUADROTOR if appropriate.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_TILTWING
entry.description: Tiltwing VTOL. Fuselage stays horizontal in all flight phases. The whole wing, along with any attached engine, can tilt between vertical and horizontal mode.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_GENERIC_MULTIROTOR
entry.description: Generic multirotor that does not fit into a specific type or whose type is unknown

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_ILLUMINATOR
entry.description: Illuminator. An illuminator is a light source that is used for lighting up dark areas external to the system: e.g. a torch or searchlight (as opposed to a light source for illuminating the system itself, e.g. an indicator light).

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_SPACECRAFT_ORBITER
entry.description: Orbiter spacecraft. Includes satellites orbiting terrestrial and extra-terrestrial bodies. Follows NASA Spacecraft Classification.

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_GROUND_QUADRUPED
entry.description: A generic four-legged ground vehicle (e.g., a robot dog).

entry.name: MAV_TYPE_VTOL_GYRODYNE
entry.description: VTOL hybrid of helicopter and autogyro. It has a main rotor for lift and separate propellers for forward flight. The rotor must be powered for hover but can autorotate in cruise flight. See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gyrodyne

message.name: NODE_INFO
message.description: Identifies a component and the application schema and firmware versions it runs. Send on startup, after reconnecting, and in response to MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE.
message.field: Functions implemented by this component.
Implementation-defined build identifier. Use the low 32 bits of the source revision when available.
Major version of this application message schema. A change indicates wire-level incompatibility.
Minor version of this application message schema. A change adds backward-compatible behavior.
Patch version of this application message schema. A change clarifies or fixes behavior without changing fields.
Firmware major version.
Firmware minor version.
Firmware patch version.
Logical role of this component.

message.name: ACTUATOR_SETPOINT
message.description: Commands one actuator. Receivers must reject stale, duplicate, unauthorized, and out-of-range commands without moving the actuator.
message.field: Sender-generated monotonically increasing identifier used for acknowledgement and duplicate suppression.
Requested actuator angle. The valid range is actuator-specific.
Time after reception at which this command becomes stale. Zero uses the receiver's configured timeout.
Maximum actuator slew rate. Zero uses the receiver's configured rate.
System ID of the intended recipient.
Component ID of the intended recipient.
Actuator to command.
Authority under which this command was produced.

message.name: ACTUATOR_STATUS
message.description: Reports actuator command progress, measured position, active authority, and faults.
message.field: Time since the reporting component booted.
Identifier of the most recently processed command.
Most recently accepted requested angle.
Measured actuator angle.
Measured angular velocity.
Active faults. Zero means no reported fault.
Actuator being reported.
Source that currently has authority.
Result or progress of the most recently processed command.
One when output to the actuator is enabled, otherwise zero.

message.name: CONTROL_AUTHORITY
message.description: Reports which control source currently owns the actuators and whether alternate sources are available.
message.field: Time since the reporting component booted.
Time remaining before the authority lease expires. Zero means no lease is active or the authority does not expire.
Source that currently has authority.
One when valid local radio-control input is available, otherwise zero.
One when commands from the main computer are available, otherwise zero.
One when local failsafe behavior is active, otherwise zero.

message.name: ENVIRONMENTAL_SAMPLE
message.description: Compact water-quality sample. Consumers must inspect valid_fields before using any measurement.
message.field: UNIX epoch time or time since system boot. The receiver can infer the time base from the magnitude.
pH multiplied by 1000.
Water temperature in centidegrees Celsius.
Dissolved oxygen in milligrams per litre multiplied by 100.
Salinity in parts per thousand multiplied by 100.
Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units multiplied by 10.
Bitmask identifying measurements that are valid.
Zero-based sensor-suite instance.

message.name: POWER_STATE
message.description: Reports the whole-boat power mode and compact supply state. Use BATTERY_STATUS when cell-level battery information is required.
message.field: Time since the reporting component booted.
Supply current. A negative value indicates charging.
Supply voltage.
Remaining charge in centipercent, from 0 to 10000.
Active power-related and system faults. Zero means no reported fault.
Current power operating mode.
One when an external charging or shore-power source is present, otherwise zero.

message.name: LINK_STATUS
message.description: Reports status and counters for one physical data link. RADIO_STATUS remains suitable for MAVLink-radio-compatible metrics.
message.field: Time since the reporting component booted.
Number of packets received on this link since boot.
Number of packets transmitted on this link since boot.
Number of receive errors since boot.
Number of transmit errors since boot.
Link-local address, such as the RYLR998 network address. Zero when not applicable.
Received signal strength. INT16_MIN when unavailable.
Signal-to-noise ratio in centibels. INT16_MIN when unavailable.
Physical link being reported.
One when the link is ready to carry packets, otherwise zero.

message.name: BUS_GRANT
message.description: Grants one component a bounded transmission slot on the half-duplex RS-485 bus. Only the bus master sends this message.
message.field: Maximum time for which the recipient may drive the bus after receiving this grant.
Maximum encoded MAVLink bytes the recipient may transmit during this grant.
Traffic classes the recipient may transmit during this grant.
System ID of the intended recipient.
Component ID of the intended recipient.
Maximum number of complete MAVLink frames the recipient may transmit during this grant.

message.name: ACTUATOR_REQUEST
message.description: Unified correlated movement envelope for absolute-angle, relative-step and stop operations. This is the single agreed request envelope for ground-issued movement; ACTUATOR_SETPOINT keeps its existing semantics unchanged for the isolated motor bench. Receivers must reject stale, duplicate, unauthorized, out-of-range, or session-mismatched requests without moving the actuator.
message.field: Ground-generated identifier unique within ground_session, echoed in REQUEST_RESULT for correlation. Monotonic per session where practical.
Random per-connection ground session identifier. A reconnect selects a new value; queued movement carrying an old session is invalid.
Absolute target angle for MOVEMENT_OPCODE_ABSOLUTE, signed relative delta resolved once against valid fresh feedback for MOVEMENT_OPCODE_STEP, and zero for MOVEMENT_OPCODE_STOP.
Freshness timeout after reception. Zero uses the receiver's configured default.
Maximum slew rate for this movement. Zero uses the receiver's configured default.
System ID of the intended recipient.
Component ID of the intended recipient.
Actuator to command.
Requested operation.
Authority under which this request was produced.

message.name: NODE_HEALTH
message.description: Per-node boot identity, uptime, faults, sensor validity and queue health. boot_id is regenerated at every boot, never hardcoded, so consumers can detect reboots and invalidate stale movement state. Link packet and error counters remain in LINK_STATUS.
message.field: Random per-boot identifier. All values from a previous boot are stale.
Time since this node booted.
Active faults. Zero means no reported fault.
Measurements currently valid at this node. Unmeasured fields elsewhere, such as SCALED_IMU magnetometer or temperature, are invalid rather than zero.
Frames dropped by this node's bounded queues since boot.
Reason for the last reset. Report RESET_REASON_UNKNOWN rather than guessing.
One when actuator position feedback is calibrated and fresh. Zero at nodes without actuator feedback.

message.name: REQUEST_RESULT
message.description: Correlated outcome of one ground movement request, sent by the boat router and targeted at the originating ground client. Terminal states remain available for later query; ground retries must not depend on this report being delivered exactly once.
message.field: ground_session from the tracked request.
request_id from the tracked request.
boot_id under which the motor node processed or rejected the request. A different boot_id means the request's outcome is unknown.
Motor-local command identifier of the accepted action, for cross-reference with ACTUATOR_STATUS.command_id. Zero when no action was accepted.
Correlation outcome of the request.
Motor-side state observation associated with this outcome.
System ID of the originating ground client.
Component ID of the originating ground client.

message.name: HEARTBEAT
message.description: The heartbeat message shows that a system or component is present and responding. The type and autopilot fields (along with the message component id), allow the receiving system to treat further messages from this system appropriately (e.g. by laying out the user interface based on the autopilot). This microservice is documented at https://mavlink.io/en/services/heartbeat.html
message.field: Vehicle or component type. For a flight controller component the vehicle type (quadrotor, helicopter, etc.). For other components the component type (e.g. camera, gimbal, etc.). This should be used in preference to component id for identifying the component type.
Autopilot type / class. Use MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID for components that are not flight controllers.
System mode bitmap.
A bitfield for use for autopilot-specific flags
System status flag.
MAVLink version, not writable by user, gets added by protocol because of magic data type: uint8_t_mavlink_version

message.name: PING
message.superseded: To be removed / merged with TIMESYNC
message.description: A ping message either requesting or responding to a ping. This allows to measure the system latencies, including serial port, radio modem and UDP connections. The ping microservice is documented at https://mavlink.io/en/services/ping.html
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX Epoch time or time since system boot). The receiving end can infer timestamp format (since 1.1.1970 or since system boot) by checking for the magnitude of the number.
PING sequence
0: request ping from all receiving systems. If greater than 0: message is a ping response and number is the system id of the requesting system
0: request ping from all receiving components. If greater than 0: message is a ping response and number is the component id of the requesting component.

message.name: SCALED_IMU
message.description: The RAW IMU readings for the usual 9DOF sensor setup. This message should contain the scaled values to the described units
message.field: Timestamp (time since system boot).
X acceleration
Y acceleration
Z acceleration
Angular speed around X axis
Angular speed around Y axis
Angular speed around Z axis
X Magnetic field
Y Magnetic field
Z Magnetic field
Temperature, 0: IMU does not provide temperature values. If the IMU is at 0C it must send 1 (0.01C).
